lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Independent application A: graphs tables and equations

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: One reference example. Use it only if you get stuck.

items.prompt:
Relationship A: y = (2/3)x
Relationship B (proportional):
x: 4, 8, 12
y: 5, 10, 15
Which relationship has the greater rate of change (unit rate)?

steps: Relationship A has a rate of change of 2/3.
Relationship B has a rate of change of 5/4 (since 5 ÷ 4 = 5/4).
5/4 is greater than 2/3, so Relationship B has the greater rate.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: For the line y = x + 14, find y when x = -2.
A line has equation y = (9/4)x - 2. Which of these equations represents a line parallel to it?
A line has equation y = (-1/4)x + 8. Write the equation of the line through (-24, -5) that is parallel to this line.
A taxi fare is given by F = 25m + 23, where F is the total fare in dollars and m is the number of miles traveled. What does the slope represent in this context?
choices: There is a base fare of $23 before any miles are traveled.
There is a base fare of $25 before any miles are traveled.
The fare increases by $25 for each additional mile traveled.
The fare increases by $23 for each additional mile traveled.

items.prompt: The amount of water in a tank is given by G = 8t + 23, where G is the number of gallons in the tank and t is the number of minutes since filling started. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The tank already had 23 gallons of water before filling started.
The tank fills at a rate of 8 gallons per minute.
The tank fills at a rate of 23 gallons per minute.
The tank already had 8 gallons of water before filling started.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (-24, -18) and (-15, -11).

A line passes through these points:
x: 17, 22, 27, 32
y: -5, 1, 7, 13
What is the slope (rate of change) of the line?

A line passes through (-15, 2). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 4 and a vertical leg (rise) of 5. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 2 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?
